title: Burning Thornwold's hollow (the Gallows Glade) itself left no collectible residue (no oil, cask, or ash) at the site or immediately after - the pitch-oil jug is simply consumed. A cask of Ironbound oil only became available much later and far away, at the Ironbound Hall in Marrowgate, gated behind Ironbound reputation. A player expecting a direct token from 'the burning' (as hinted by later throne mechanics) would find nothing at Thornwold itself.
where: The Burned Glade (Thornwold) - no pickup after the burn action
